dataRecordMapping.description:
Provides a mapping from a data record returned by an api call, which may be in any shape,
to the shape required by the concrete data spec setting type implementation.

title:
Glyphs are circular annotations or badges which can be applied to items. They can be used to report information about
an item, or to allow user interaction.  On nodes, glyphs are drawn along the border at a compass position.
name: UiSdlGraphVisualizationNodeGlyphConfig
